statements.t: Awarded a $4.5 million contract in July 2026 from the DoW for the development of alternative refractory alloy powders to reduce cost and dependence on foreign sources of critical raw materials; two high-temperature alloys have been down-selected and produced on the Company’s gas atomization technology, and the 13-month program is expected to be completed in August 2027.
With the introduction of fourth quarter 2026 revenue guidance, we are giving investors greater visibility into the trajectory of the business.

With the production equipment and the plant operating and technical teams supporting both its metal powders and PM-HIP product lines largely in place, the Company does not expect these fixed production costs to increase in proportion to revenue.
As a result, the Company expects future revenue growth to drive operating leverage and improvement in gross margin.
